name: godmode
description: GodMode: No More Later — progressive bodyweight challenge planner. Open source, account-based, invite-only.

scripts.token: npm run --silent build:server && node dist-server/server/index.js token
scripts.serve: npm run build:server && GODMODE_DEV_TOKEN="$(node dist-server/server/index.js token)" node dist-server/server/index.js
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.preview:pwa: GODMODE_SW_LOCAL=1 npm run build && vite preview
